| description = I ran into this guy trying to sneak in to get a hole key. He is upstairs in the archway near the bank/hole key vendor. He hit like a truck but didn't cast or use any abilities when he killed me. Cons yellow to level 60. Does not see invis. On [[Heretics]] faction like all other skele guards.


On blue he was indifferent to my iksar monk and did not aggro despite being KoS to heretics. On green I aggroed a guard and pulled it past him which he harm touched and killed the guard but not me. Was indifferent to my erudite necro despite being max ally with heretics.

Have seen him randomly kill the vendors in his house, he was on 60% after he killed both.
